{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000003MZY1ZQHQND3W","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x192
group app "App layer" {
  node Shell "Composer App" ref="packages/apps/composer-app"
  node Framework "App Framework" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework"
  node CorePlugins "Core Plugins" ref="packages/apps/composer-app/src/plugin-defs.core.tsx"
  node FeaturePlugins "Feature Plugins" ref="packages/plugins"
  node Ui "React UI" ref="packages/ui/react-ui"
}
group sdk "SDK and data" {
  node Client "Client SDK" ref="packages/sdk/client"
  node Services "Client Services" ref="packages/sdk/client-services"
  node Echo "ECHO" ref="packages/core/echo"
  node Halo "HALO Identity" ref="packages/core/halo"
  node Mesh "MESH Network" ref="packages/core/mesh"
  node Compute "Compute" ref="packages/core/compute"
}
group remote "Remote" {
  node Edge "EDGE" ref="packages/core/mesh/edge-client"
}
edge Shell composes Framework "boots"
edge Shell -> CorePlugins
edge Shell -> FeaturePlugins
edge CorePlugins -> Framework
edge FeaturePlugins -> Framework
edge FeaturePlugins -> Ui "renders"
edge CorePlugins -> Client
edge Framework -> Compute "operations"
edge Client -> Services "RPC"
edge Services owns Echo
edge Services owns Halo
edge Services -> Mesh
edge Echo -> Edge "sync"
edge Mesh -> Edge
edge Compute -> Echo
edge Compute -> Edge "remote invoke"
"},"objects":[
